contract.note: Operational continuity is a fair ordinary reading. Distinguishing necessary financing from discretionary fundraising preserves the speaker's commitment.

OpenAI discloses a corporate restructuring. This does not establish required financing or durable operational self-sufficiency.

reviews.rationale: No deadline was supplied, and neither disclosure meets the early-resolution rule. Committed fundraising does not demonstrate necessary maintenance financing; restructuring does not demonstrate durable self-financing.
